title: Joshua Chapter 21 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Joshua chapter 21 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Joshua Chapter 21 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Joshua Chapter 21.

questions.question: Who came near to Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun in Joshua 21?
options: The heads of the fathers of the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: The heads of the fathers of the Levites
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:1 states that the heads of the fathers of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun.

questions.question: Where did the Levite heads speak to Eleazar and Joshua about the LORD's command?
options: At Shiloh in the land of Canaan
questions.correctAnswer: At Shiloh in the land of Canaan
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:2 records that the Levite heads spoke to Eleazar and Joshua at Shiloh in the land of Canaan.

questions.question: What did the LORD command by the hand of Moses to give to the Levites?
options: Cities to dwell in, with suburbs for their cattle
questions.correctAnswer: Cities to dwell in, with suburbs for their cattle
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:2 says the LORD commanded by Moses to give the Levites cities to dwell in along with their suburbs for their cattle.

questions.question: Who gave the Levites cities and their suburbs out of their inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:3 states that the children of Israel gave the Levites cities and suburbs out of their inheritance as commanded by the LORD.

questions.question: How many cities did the children of Aaron, who were Kohathites, receive by lot?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:4 explains that the children of Aaron, priests who were Kohathites, received thirteen cities by lot.

questions.question: From which tribes did the children of Aaron receive their cities?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:4 states that the children of Aaron received cities from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

questions.question: Which families had ten cities by lot out of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and half of Manasseh?
options: The rest of the children of Kohath
questions.correctAnswer: The rest of the children of Kohath
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:5 reveals that the rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and half tribe of Manasseh.

questions.question: How many cities did the children of Gershon receive by lot?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:6 states that the children of Gershon received thirteen cities by lot.

questions.question: From which tribes did the children of Gershon receive their cities?
options: Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan
Ephraim, Dan, and half tribe of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:6 describes that the children of Gershon received cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

questions.question: How many cities did the children of Merari receive by lot from their families?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:7 tells us that the children of Merari had twelve cities by lot from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

questions.question: True or False: The children of Israel gave the Levites cities with their suburbs as commanded by the LORD through Moses.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:8 confirms that the children of Israel gave the Levites these cities with suburbs as the LORD commanded through Moses.

questions.question: True or False: The city of Hebron was given to Caleb, including its fields and villages.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:12 states that the fields and villages of Hebron were given to Caleb as his possession.

questions.question: True or False: The children of Aaron had the last lot of cities among the Levites.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:10 says the children of Aaron had the first lot, not the last.

questions.question: True or False: The children of Aaron had exactly thirteen cities with their suburbs.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:19 confirms that the children of Aaron had thirteen cities with their suburbs.

questions.question: Which city was given to the children of Aaron that was known as the city of Arba, father of Anak?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:11 says that the city of Arba, father of Anak, is Hebron and it was given to the children of Aaron.

medium.title: Joshua Chapter 21 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Joshua Chapter 21 to real-life situations.

questions.question: How many cities were given to the children of Aaron, the priests, according to Joshua 21?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:19 states that all the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs. This is supported by verses 10-19 which list these cities.

questions.question: Which tribe provided cities for the families of the children of Kohath who remained?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:20 explains that the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, had their cities out of the tribe of Ephraim. This is further detailed in verses 21-26.

questions.question: What purpose is given for the city of Shechem in Mount Ephraim?
options: A city of refuge for the slayer
A royal city for the king
A city of trade and commerce
A city for the Levites' cattle
questions.correctAnswer: A city of refuge for the slayer
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:21 states that Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim was given to be a city of refuge for the slayer, showing the provision for protection and justice among the Israelites.

questions.question: How many cities were given to the families of the children of Kohath remaining, according to Joshua 21:26?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:26 summarizes that all the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained, as detailed in the preceding verses.

questions.question: Which city was given to the children of Gershon out of the other half tribe of Manasseh to be a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:27 explains that Golan in Bashan with her suburbs was given to the children of Gershon from the other half tribe of Manasseh as a city of refuge for the slayer.

questions.question: Which tribe donated the cities of Kishon, Dabareh, Jarmuth, and Engannim to the Gershonites?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:28-29 list these four cities with their suburbs as given out of the tribe of Issachar to the children of Gershon.

questions.question: How does the passage in Joshua 21 teach about God's provision for the Levites in relation to faith and trust?
options: God commands the Levites to build their own cities without help
God provides cities and suburbs to the Levites as He promised, showing His faithfulness
The Levites are left to find places to live on their own
The Levites receive land only after they conquer it themselves
questions.correctAnswer: God provides cities and suburbs to the Levites as He promised, showing His faithfulness
questions.explanation: Verses 1-4 and 43-45 show that God commanded the giving of cities to the Levites and fulfilled His promises, demonstrating the importance of trusting God's provision throughout Joshua 21.

questions.question: What practical lesson about obedience can be learned from the way Israel allocated cities to the Levites?
options: Obedience leads to division and conflict among tribes
Obedience to God's command results in order and blessings
Obedience is optional when it comes to God's instructions
questions.correctAnswer: Obedience to God's command results in order and blessings
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:3 and 21:43-45 show that Israel obeyed the LORD's command to give cities to the Levites and as a result, they possessed the land and had rest, indicating blessings from obedience.

questions.question: According to Joshua 21:38-39, what virtue does the designation of Ramoth in Gilead as a city of refuge teach us?
questions.explanation: The city of Ramoth in Gilead was given as a city of refuge for the slayer (Joshua 21:38-39), demonstrating God's provision for justice and protection, which requires integrity to uphold.

questions.question: True or False: All the cities given to the Levites had suburbs around them as part of their inheritance.
questions.explanation: Throughout Joshua 21, every city given to the Levites is mentioned along with its suburbs (e.g., Joshua 21:16, 21:21, 21:34), indicating that suburbs were included in their inheritance.

questions.question: True or False: The children of Levi received no cities from the tribe of Dan.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:23-24 shows that the tribe of Dan gave four cities with suburbs to the children of Kohath, part of the Levites, indicating they did receive cities from Dan.

questions.question: True or False: The cities given to the children of Merari outnumber those given to the children of Gershon.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:33 states Gershonites received thirteen cities, while Joshua 21:40 states Merari’s families received twelve cities, so Gershonites received more cities than Merari.

questions.question: What does Joshua 21:44 promise will happen if Israel possesses the land as commanded?
options: Their enemies will rise against them
They will have rest round about and no enemies will stand before them
They will lose the land to other nations
They must fight endlessly for the land
questions.correctAnswer: They will have rest round about and no enemies will stand before them
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:44 promises that the LORD gave Israel rest round about according to His oath and no enemy stood before them, confirming God's protection upon obedience.

questions.question: According to Joshua 21, how does the designation of cities of refuge teach us about forgiveness and justice?
options: Cities of refuge balance protection for the innocent with justice for the guilty
Cities of refuge are only symbolic with no practical use
Cities of refuge were given only to the priests
questions.correctAnswer: Cities of refuge balance protection for the innocent with justice for the guilty
questions.explanation: Several cities such as Shechem (21:21), Golan (21:27), and Ramoth in Gilead (21:38) were designated cities of refuge, providing protection for those who accidentally killed someone while ensuring justice is served, teaching forgiveness and justice in balance.

questions.question: What lesson about generosity can a believer learn from the children of Israel giving cities to the Levites?
options: Generosity is only shown through money
Generosity includes giving land and resources to support God's servants
Generosity is not important in God's plan
Generosity should only be shown to family
questions.correctAnswer: Generosity includes giving land and resources to support God's servants
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:3 shows that the children of Israel gave cities from their inheritance to the Levites as commanded by the LORD, demonstrating practical generosity supporting those who serve God.

hard.title: Joshua Chapter 21 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Joshua Chapter 21.

questions.question: Which tribe was given the city of Golan in Bashan, designated as a city of refuge?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:27 states that the city of Golan in Bashan was given to the children of Gershon to be a city of refuge for the slayer.

questions.question: How many cities with their suburbs were given to the children of Gershon according to their families?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:33 clearly states that all the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

questions.question: What was the total number of cities given to the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:41 notes that all the cities of the Levites within the possession of Israel were forty-eight cities with their suburbs.

questions.question: Which city, given to the tribe of Naphtali, served as a city of refuge and is located in Galilee?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:32 identifies Kedesh in Galilee as a city of refuge given to the tribe of Naphtali.

questions.question: Which tribe was allocated the city of Jokneam with its suburbs?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:34 details that Jokneam with its suburbs was given to the families of the children of Merari from the tribe of Zebulun.

questions.question: Ramoth in Gilead, a city of refuge, was given to which tribe?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:38 states that Ramoth in Gilead, designated as a city of refuge, was given to the tribe of Gad.

questions.question: According to Joshua 21, which literary device is used in the listing of cities and their suburbs as a way to emphasize completeness and fulfillment?
questions.explanation: The chapter uses an inclusio literary device framing the list of cities with phrases about their suburbs and the fulfillment of God's promise, emphasizing completeness (Joshua 21:42-45).

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word 'refuge' (used for cities of refuge) imply in the context of Joshua 21?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term often translated as 'refuge' (מַקְלֵט, maqleṭ) in Joshua 21 signifies a safe haven for those who unintentionally committed manslaughter, as seen in cities of refuge (Joshua 21:13, 27, 32, 38).

questions.question: Which other Old Testament passage is closely connected to the theme of cities of refuge as given in Joshua 21?
questions.explanation: Numbers 35 establishes the ordinance of cities of refuge for manslayers, which Joshua 21 fulfills in the allocation of these cities to the Levites (Numbers 35:6-34).

questions.question: How does Joshua 21:43-45 fulfill the promises made in earlier books of the Torah?
options: By showing Israel possessed the land and had peace
By initiating the building of the temple
By recounting the judges of Israel
By detailing the genealogy of the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: By showing Israel possessed the land and had peace
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:43-45 confirms the LORD gave Israel all the land He promised and gave them rest without enemies, fulfilling the covenant promises from Exodus and Deuteronomy.

questions.question: Which tribe received the city of Shechem with its suburbs as part of the Kohathite Levite inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:20-21 states that the families of Kohath who remained received cities out of the tribe of Ephraim, including Shechem as a city of refuge.

questions.question: Which city was given to Caleb the son of Jephunneh, distinct from the Levite cities?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:12 clarifies that while Hebron city was given to the children of Aaron, the fields and villages of Hebron were given to Caleb as his possession.

questions.question: True or False: According to Joshua 21, all the Levite cities were distributed evenly among the three families: Kohathites, Gershonites, and Merarites.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21 shows the Levite cities were distributed by lot but unevenly among the families: 13 to Kohathites (Aaron's family included), 13 to Gershonites, and 12 to Merarites (Joshua 21:26, 33, 40).

questions.question: True or False: Joshua 21 concludes with a statement affirming that every promise God made to Israel was fulfilled without failure.
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:45 states that not one good thing failed of all the promises the LORD made to Israel; all came to pass, confirming total fulfillment.

questions.question: Which New Testament book echoes the fulfillment theme of God's promises seen in Joshua 21:45?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 10:23 speaks of God’s faithfulness to His promises, echoing the fulfillment theme emphasized in Joshua 21:45 where all God's promises to Israel were fulfilled.

theological.title: Joshua Chapter 21 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Joshua Chapter 21 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Joshua 21:1 reveal about the role of the Levites in Israel's tribal structure?
options: They were tribal leaders with military authority
They represented a distinct hereditary priestly class
They were landowners like other tribes
They acted as political rulers over Israel
questions.correctAnswer: They represented a distinct hereditary priestly class
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:1 shows the heads of the Levite families approaching Eleazar the priest and Joshua, indicating their unique priestly role distinct from other tribal leaders.

questions.question: According to Joshua 21:2, why did the Levites request cities and their suburbs from the other tribes?
options: To fulfill a command of the LORD given through Moses
To create trade centers for commerce
To build fortified cities for protection
questions.correctAnswer: To fulfill a command of the LORD given through Moses
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:2 explicitly states that the Levites reminded the leaders that the LORD commanded through Moses that they be given cities with suburbs for their cattle, showing divine provision for their inheritance.

questions.question: What theological doctrine is illustrated by the giving of cities to the Levites as described in Joshua 21:3?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:3 shows that the children of Israel gave cities to the Levites by the LORD's command, demonstrating God's providential care in providing for the priestly tribe's needs.

questions.question: How does the distribution of cities to the Kohathites in Joshua 21:4 reflect God's justice?
options: All received equal numbers of cities regardless of family size
The Aaronic priests received the first and more inheritance
Cities were given only outside Israel's land
questions.correctAnswer: The Aaronic priests received the first and more inheritance
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:4 indicates that the Aaronic priests, a subset of the Kohathites, received thirteen cities by lot first, showing God's just distribution according to their priestly role.

questions.question: What does the allocation of cities from tribes like Ephraim, Dan, and half of Manasseh to the Kohathites in Joshua 21:5 signify about Israel's unity?
options: The Levites were isolated from other tribes
The Levites were supported by multiple tribes indicating intertribal cooperation
The Levites only received cities from their own tribe
The Levites conquered territories on their own
questions.correctAnswer: The Levites were supported by multiple tribes indicating intertribal cooperation
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:5 shows the Kohathites received cities from several tribes, demonstrating the cooperative nature of Israel's tribal system in supporting the priestly tribe.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal teaching do Joshua 21:11 and Joshua 21:13 convey about the cities given to the priests?
options: They were primarily economic trade centers
They functioned as cities of refuge and priestly dwelling places
They were fully fortified military cities
questions.correctAnswer: They functioned as cities of refuge and priestly dwelling places
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:11 and 21:13 show Hebron and other cities given to the priests served as cities of refuge, highlighting God's provision for justice and sanctuary through the priestly tribe.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is most clearly demonstrated by the LORD giving Israel rest and victory over their enemies as stated in Joshua 21:44?
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:44 emphasizes the LORD's faithfulness in granting rest and delivering enemies, fulfilling His promises made to Israel's fathers.

questions.question: How does the allotment of cities in Joshua 21:27 to the Gershonites in Bashan relate to the broader biblical theme of refuge and sanctuary?
options: The cities were places for military training
The cities served as cities of refuge providing protection for the slayer
The cities were economic hubs for the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: The cities served as cities of refuge providing protection for the slayer
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:27 explicitly states Golan was given as a city of refuge, emphasizing God's provision for justice and mercy within Israel's covenant community.

questions.question: What does the total number of cities given to the Levites (Joshua 21:41) signify in terms of their role within Israel?
options: They were integrated throughout Israel to serve all tribes
They were isolated in one region
They were only given land in the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: They were integrated throughout Israel to serve all tribes
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:41 shows 48 cities were given to the Levites across Israel, indicating their role as spiritual mediators accessible to all tribes.

questions.question: What combined theological insight do Joshua 21:43 and Joshua 21:45 provide regarding God's covenant and promises?
options: God's promises are conditional and often fail
God fulfills His covenant promises perfectly and gives rest
God's promises depend on Israel's military strength
God's promises are symbolic without literal fulfillment
questions.correctAnswer: God fulfills His covenant promises perfectly and gives rest
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:43 and 21:45 affirm that the LORD gave Israel the land He swore to their fathers and that nothing failed of His good promises, demonstrating divine faithfulness and covenant fulfillment.

questions.question: How does the allocation of cities of refuge in Joshua 21:32 and Joshua 21:38 reveal God's justice and mercy in Israel's legal system?
options: They emphasize harsh punishment without protection
They provide safe havens for unintentional manslayers, balancing justice and mercy
They were political centers unrelated to justice
questions.correctAnswer: They provide safe havens for unintentional manslayers, balancing justice and mercy
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:32 and 21:38 describe cities designated as refuges for the slayer, showing God's provision of mercy within the legal system to protect innocent life and administer justice.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth about God's sovereignty is demonstrated by God's giving the Levite cities by lot as described in Joshua 21:8?
options: God leaves all decisions to human chance
God sovereignly directs even the casting of lots to fulfill His will
God does not care about land distribution
God only intervenes in spiritual matters
questions.correctAnswer: God sovereignly directs even the casting of lots to fulfill His will
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:8 shows the Levite cities were given by lot as the LORD commanded, illustrating God’s sovereign control over seemingly random events.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the allocation of cities to the Levites in Joshua 21:20-26 was merely a political act without theological meaning. What does the text actually teach about this allocation?
options: It was a political act to appease the Levites
It was a divine ordinance reflecting God's provision for His priests
It was a random distribution with no significance
It was an act of rebellion against tribal leaders
questions.correctAnswer: It was a divine ordinance reflecting God's provision for His priests
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:20-26 details the cities given by lot to the Kohathites, emphasizing these allocations were commanded by the LORD through Moses, showing divine provision rather than mere politics.

questions.question: How does the mention of Caleb's possession in Joshua 21:12 illustrate God's reward for faithfulness and obedience?
options: Caleb was given the entire land of Canaan
Caleb received fields and villages as a personal inheritance due to his faith
questions.correctAnswer: Caleb received fields and villages as a personal inheritance due to his faith
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:12 notes that while Hebron was given to the priests, Caleb received the fields and villages as his possession, rewarding his faithfulness (cf. Numbers 14:24).

questions.question: What does the distribution of cities among the Levite families in Joshua 21:34-40 teach about God's orderly provision within the covenant community?
options: God's provision was chaotic and unfair
God distributed cities by family tribe, maintaining order and justice
Only one Levite family received cities
The Levites were excluded from the land
questions.correctAnswer: God distributed cities by family tribe, maintaining order and justice
questions.explanation: Joshua 21:34-40 describes cities given to the Merarite Levites from various tribes, reflecting God's orderly and just provision within Israel's covenant community.
